description: Source code for Anthropic API provider handler class, managing message creation, token counting, and model configuration for Anthropic models within a larger AI framework.

classes.name: AnthropicHandler
classes.description: Handles interactions with Anthropic API, including message streaming, prompt completion, token counting, and model configuration.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Generates a message stream to the Anthropic API based on system prompt, messages, and metadata, handling streaming response and usage tracking.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the current model configuration, adjusting for special cases like 1M context beta models.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt synchronously using the Anthropic API.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens for given content blocks using Anthropic's API, with fallback to local estimation on failure.
